goal.vi: Hỏi cỡ, thử đồ, hỏi giá và quyết định mua.
goal.en: Ask for a size, try something on, ask the price and decide to buy.

lines: Hi! Can I help you find anything?
Excuse me, do you have this in a medium?
Let me check. Yes, here you go.
Sure, the fitting rooms are over there.
It fits! How much is it?

mean.vi: Nói bạn chỉ xem hàng, chưa cần giúp
mean.en: Say you are only looking and don't need help yet

why.vi: Câu kia nghe hơi lạnh; câu này lịch sự và rất bình thường trong cửa hàng.
why.en: The other sounds a bit cold; this is polite and normal in a shop.

phrases.say: Do you have this in a medium?
phrases.not: Is there medium size of this?

mean.en: Ask for another size or color

why.vi: Dùng "Do you have this in…?" cho cỡ và màu.
why.en: Use "Do you have this in…?" for sizes and colors.

mean.vi: Xin mặc thử quần áo hoặc đi thử giày
mean.en: Ask to put on clothes or shoes before you buy

why.vi: Với quần áo, giày dép nói "try it on"; "try it" thường là nếm hoặc thử dùng.
why.en: For clothes and shoes, say "try it on"; "try it" usually means taste or test.

why.vi: "How much is it?" là câu hỏi đầy đủ, lịch sự; câu kia nghe cụt.
why.en: "How much is it?" is a full, polite question; the other sounds not complete.

mean.en: Say you have decided to buy it

why.vi: Trong cửa hàng, khi chốt mua người ta nói "I'll take it."
why.en: In a shop, when you decide to buy, people say "I'll take it."

mean.vi: Nói nhẹ nhàng rằng món đồ chưa vừa
mean.en: Say gently that something doesn't fit

why.vi: "A bit too…" là cách mềm mỏng để nói có vấn đề.
why.en: "A bit too…" is a soft, polite way to say there is a problem.

mean.vi: Hỏi trả lại hàng đã mua
mean.en: Ask to bring something back to the shop

why.vi: Dùng động từ "return" khi mang hàng trả lại cửa hàng.
why.en: Use the verb "return" when you take something back to a shop.

ai.name: Maya
ai.role: a shop assistant in a clothes shop
ai.goal: help the learner find the right size and buy a shirt

roleplay.you: Look around, ask for your size, try the shirt on, ask the price and buy it.

turns.a: Hi! Can I help you find anything?
That shirt is new this week. Do you like it?
turns.h: Yes! Do you have this in a medium?
br: Let me check… yes, we do.

turns.a: Here you go. Would you like to try it on?
turns.h: Yes, please. Where are the fitting rooms?
It fits well. How much is it?
br: Oh, I can get you another size.

turns.a: It's on sale today, so it's only twenty dollars.

roleplay.end: You can pay at the front. Thanks for shopping with us!
